note: measurement, never certification — test-vector expectations, not verdicts about the world

against_production_pin_set.why: the vector key is not a published did:web:csoai.org identity, so the most a pinned verifier may say is self-consistent-only; it must never be collapsed into pass or fail

vector-2-tampered.why: one payload byte flipped; the Ed25519 signature must not verify over the reconstructed Sig_structure
